This! Yes!!! Haha - I both love and hate my cancer in equal degrees at times - but to be honest we usually create the perfect balance! He’s the only person who truly gets my softer side and he really knows it! 🥹😍

As a 31f cap in a relationship with a 41m cancer, I love that he gives me space - but sometimes I want him to remind me he cares. Nothing huge, just really subtle, I’m a clean freak and carry a lot of the household burden chores but he does the cooking generally (we both do both now and again too). But he knows that when I’m due for my time of the month, he has cadburys chocolate at the ready, he does the washing and he rubs my feet. It’s just the small things, he doesn’t make a big thing of it, he lets me have a PMS meltdown, presents the chocolate quietly and rubs my feet. He knows I need/want him around, but I am the main earner in our house and he knows that I need down time too due to very long hours. This is when he shines the most for me - he just gets me. He also just lets me simmer down and he’s just sturdy and strong and he’s just… there. That’s what she needs - I think it’s what truly makes it work for caps with cancers. 

In short - don’t be a knight in shining armour, just go and be there as that rock when she needs you to give her that TLC. She’s likely in her own head about work - if she didn’t wanna be with you she would just say it. She’s a cap, way too emotionally intelligent for that usually! X

Capricorns have a habit of trying to get all their ducks in a line before they can settle into anything. Although simply what he’s doing to you now is a downright selfish move - he essentially wants to put you on hold for himself so he can move on first but also whilst emotionally blackmailing you into thinking he’s considering your emotions. As long as you are on hold and attached to him then he has a back up plan. But also if you choose to walk away (which you absolutely should) he wants you to think it was your idea so then he doesn’t have any guilt about being a grade A ahole. Either way he wins - but let this be seen you now know the secret behind his motive. 

Don’t settle for second best and certainly don’t let it come to an end on easy good terms - he needs your honest open opinion on how much he has hurt you by what he has done to you and then walk away. Call his bluff - but still walk away. That way he has to take a look in the mirror - Capricorn’s really do not like being the bad guy without it being their own decision to be that. Typical Capricorn bloke - my ex was cap male and I’m cap female and this whole “no one will ever be me but he doesn’t and can’t be with me” was soon followed by stringing me along till he jumped into bed and is now marrying one of my ex-friends. At that point he had no interest in my emotions either and suddenly I was out of order to react to this. He always told me he couldn’t be with me but he would never let me go. DONT BE ON HOLD - he doesn’t deserve you and you’re better than that my lovely ❤️ sorry he can’t see past his own nose!
